mapper.sql: id, user_id, version, snapshot_time, scope_code, catalog_name, database_name, table_name, column_name, accesses, source_kinds
mapper.select: select distinct s.user_id from t_r_data_perm_user_effective_snapshot s inner join ( select user_id, max(version) as lv from t_r_data_perm_user_effective_snapshot group by user_id ) lv on lv.user_id = s.user_id and lv.lv = s.version where s.scope_code is not null
mapper.insert:
insert into t_r_data_perm_user_effective_snapshot (user_id, version, snapshot_time, scope_code, catalog_name, database_name, table_name, column_name, accesses, source_kinds) values
(#{r.userId}, #{r.version}, #{r.snapshotTime}, #{r.scopeCode}, #{r.catalogName}, #{r.databaseName}, #{r.tableName}, #{r.columnName}, #{r.accesses}, #{r.sourceKinds})
